thread:
kevin: hey everyone, first week q: who9s the owner for the Model Serving "runtime" docs and the permission list for pushing model bundles? want to avoid breaking prod when i add a small eval job.

priya: welcome @kevin! :wave: short answer: model-serving runtime + infra bits -> eng-runtime; packaging & model registry perms -> eng-platform; deployment approvals for prod -> infra-safety (safety gate).

kevin: nice 8077; where are the exact docs/repos?

priya: docs: https://redwood.internal/docs/serving-models and the repo is `models/serving` (top-level). Runtime configs live in `deploy/runtime-configs/` and registry ACLs in `platform/model-registry/ACL.md`.

kevin: do i need a ticket to get write access to `platform/model-registry`?

tom: yes if you9re not already in the group. File a ticket in #eng-infra with this minimal template (paste in the channel):
```
Request: write access to model-registry
Service: Model Registry (platform/model-registry)
Requested by: kevin
Reason: add evaluation bundle and update metadata
Approver: your manager
Urgency: low
```
Also cc @eng-platform in the thread.

kevin: okay, and who signs off on prod deploys?

priya: For production model bundles we need a safety review: @model-safety-team review + @eng-sre for rollout plan. If the change touches runtime config then schedule a brief canary (15-30m) and notify #eng-oncall.

infra-bot: Current model-serving oncall: dana -> liu. Next rotation: 2026-04-02 08:00 UTC. Pager channel: #eng-oncall-models.

kevin: is there an escalation matrix for incidents if a model causes high CPU/latency?

tom: escalation: pager -> oncall -> eng-sre lead -> eng-runtime manager. For severity that impacts customers, also ping @customer-success and @support-lead. We keep contact points in the Ownership Matrix (internal).

kevin: is there a place for emergency phone numbers or backups?

priya: urgent contacts are in the secure Owners sheet (KMS protected). Email `security-access@redwood.com` to request view access. For immediate escalations use the pager first.

kevin: thanks! last bit 014 any onboarding checklist for model engineers so i don9t miss steps?

people-ops: hey @kevin, we have a New Model Engineer checklist in People Ops drive: https://drive.google.com/po/onboarding-models. It covers repo access, meeting the oncall buddy, security training, and adding yourself to the Ownership Matrix. If you want a quick walkthrough we can schedule a 30m buddy session.

kevin: super helpful 8079; i'll open the infra ticket now and ping eng-platform.

priya: ping me if access stalls, happy to nudge. Also once you have access run: ```/oncall add @kevin Model-Serving --start 2026-04-05``` to add yourself to the rota (if applicable).

kevin: will do, thanks everyone!
